title: AIVNote
description: Kevin Amundson's interpretive or pastoral comment for the AIV writer/reader. Never Scripture. Never mixed into a Free Use Bible API or local USX chapter payload. UI must always show the never-Scripture label. M2: rich body + inclusive range→verseIds.

schemaVersion.description: Bump only with a coordinated NOTES-CONTRACT.md change.

id.description: Stable note id. Also used as storage filename stem.

label.description: Never-Scripture label. Required on every note object and must be rendered verbatim at the top of every note block in the UI (Bezalel olive pane).

status.description: Writer workflow only. draft-for-kevin may stay private/house; public visibility should require approved-by-kevin (app policy).

visibility.description: private = Kevin only; house = AIV agents/Steward circle; public = reader-visible when the notes pane is shipped.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the note record was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC when body/status/visibility last changed.

range.description: Inclusive attachment passage (where the note hangs). Uses USFM book ids. M2: UI expands verseIds from start–end as an inclusive contiguous same-chapter range first.

verseIds.description: Canonical join keys: {USFM}.{chapter}.{verse} e.g. GEN.1.1. Must equal the inclusive expansion of range (same book+chapter) for M2 writer saves. Independent of translation wording. Primary index for storage and reader joins.

scriptureCite.description: Optional citation of the text the note was written beside. Not the note body. Do not store full chapter JSON here.

body.description: Note body. Prefer markdown text as the durable form. format=document may carry TipTap JSON in `document` while `text` remains a markdown serialization.

format.description: markdown = text is source of truth; document = TipTap JSON in `document`, text still required as markdown export.

text.description: Kevin's comment as markdown (or markdown export). Supports **bold**, *italic*, [label](https://...), and scripture refs [[GEN.1.1]] / display GEN 1:1–3. Never presented as Scripture.

document.description: Optional TipTap/ProseMirror JSON when format is document. Must not replace `text`.
